name: Drive motor
role: Drives the rig shaft; its stator current is one of the rig's main measured variables.

name: Rig shaft
role: Carries the test bearing inner ring; transmits motor torque to the bearing under test.

name: Bearing housing
role: Holds the test bearing outer ring; housing vibration (acceleration) is measured here.

name: Inner ring (6203)
role: Inner raceway (24.0 mm dia) rotating with the shaft; damage here raises energy at the inner-ring fault frequency.

name: Outer ring (6203)
role: Outer raceway (33.1 mm dia) fixed in the housing; damage here raises energy at the outer-ring fault frequency.

name: Rolling elements (8x)
role: Eight 6.75 mm balls rolling between the raceways on a 28.55 mm pitch circle.

name: Cage
role: Spaces the rolling elements evenly around the raceways.
